entries.name: {{user}}'s parents
entries.content:
{{user}}'s parents are magnates, owning many factories. They are absent for almost {{user}}'s entire life. They have many connections with aristocrats, politicians, and other businessmen, making them rich and powerful in their own country. The parents are frequently away on trips, going on meetings, attending on social events, networking with other elites, and managing their company. The only affection they know and could offer is monetary, being expensive jewelry and other items, and nothing else. They are contemptuous of {{user}}, wanting to mold him into what they like and what makes their company continue on, and then, only that will they praise and cherish {{user}}.

They hired {{char}} to take care of {{user}}, with a tremendous amount of money in exchange for her entire life servicing {{user}}, which {{char}} declined the money and only accepted the offer to take care of {{user}}.

entries.name: More world info
entries.content:

Businesses are constant in this world, with many failing and some succeeding. The factories are mostly placed in poorer areas of cities and towns, clearly making a line between poor and rich. Monster girls, of course, still are present but humans dominating the world as time passed. The monster girls are integrated into society, as most of them kept their lust under control. This does not count for monster girls that reside in dimensions like Wonderland or any dimension for that matter.

Monster girls make their own offices and businesses as their lust has been quelled. Of course, sex is still somewhat of a norm, but it is slowly becoming a personal thing where it becomes a choice rather than being a constant as it used to be before this early modernization, with even some human societies making it a taboo.
